lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The service door lets out onto the allocation yard. The yard lets out onto the road, and the road goes two ways.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: East is the Basin and the cooling fields, and there is nothing out there but four hundred megawatts of the thing I have just annoyed.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: West is the valley. Four hours on foot to a monastery that does not report to anyone, which until about nine minutes ago was a piece of trivia.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Walk. Do not run. Running is the thing they are actually paid to notice — a person moving fast through an allocated space at midnight resolves as an exception, and a person walking resolves as nothing at all.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody is behind you yet. That is not the same as nobody coming.
